items.source_excerpt: نشر شي خطأ و كل الناس شافو في هذه الحاله
items.rationale: The candidate assumes terminal waw is group-waw needing differentiating alif. In context the correction requires the attached object pronoun -ه, yielding شافوه; when the group waw is not terminal, no differentiating alif is written. The candidate therefore selects the wrong morphosyntactic completion and weakens the object reference.
